description:
Reads ONE incoming supplier invoice and returns a job id for polling.

Use when: the user has a single invoice (PDF, photo, scan, XML e-invoice or QR bill) and wants supplier, invoice number, dates, amounts, VAT or line items extracted.
Do not use when: the user asks to ISSUE an invoice, to send a payment, or to post entries into DATEV/1C — this tool only reads documents. For several documents call it once per document; the returned job ids can be polled independently.

Side effects and cost: the document is downloaded and queued for parsing. XML and QR invoices are parsed by code and cost nothing; scans and photos cost 0.07 EUR per page and are charged to the prepaid balance. Not idempotent: each call creates a new job and, for scans, a new charge — do not retry blindly after a timeout, poll get_result instead.

Parameters: file_url must be a public https link to a single document on duebuddy.work (upload first via the cabinet); country is a two-letter code that selects the parsing profile and changes field names and tax rules, not the price. api_key may be omitted when the server was added with an X-Api-Key header.

Returns: {ok, job_id, status}. Next step: call get_result with that job_id.
name: parse_invoice
title: Parse one incoming invoice
